text:
riley: Quick sync  Regulatory customer (MedSecure) asked for a per-route compliance add-on: DLP scanning + private audit logs + higher-retention observability. They want pricing and launch criteria before pilot.

deepa: Scope: per-route DLP (inline redaction or block), encrypted private audit export (S3/OnPrem), and 365-day observability retention. They will not accept changes to core SLA but will pay premium for compliance features.

tom: Engineering notes: inline DLP needs CPU work and increases latency; prefer async scan with decision-flag to reduce p99 impact. Private audit export requires per-tenant encryption keys and export pipe. Ops impact: storage growth and egress.

grant: Finance: propose a two-part price: fixed monthly compliance entitlement fee + per-token inspection surcharge. Example: $2,000/month + $0.002/inspectedK tokens. Also require minimum 6-month pilot fee.

legalbot: Contract points: must include liability carveouts for false negatives, and explicit customer opt-in for redaction. Also limit retention scope and set export access controls.

opsbot: Operational constraints: retention 365d means retention storage estimates. Need telemetry quota to alert when export backlog exceeds threshold. Also require KMS integration (customer-managed keys) for private export.

riley: Product surface: add route-level `compliance_addon` with fields: mode (blocking|redact|async), retention_days, export_target. Console should show daily inspected tokens and remaining export backlog.

deepa: Recommended default: async scan + redaction option; blocking only for small routes due to latency. Must include rollout guardrails and canary traffic.

grant: Draft billing line: "Compliance Add-on: $2,000/month entitlement plus $0.002 per inspected K tokens. Includes 365-day private audit retention and secure export. Minimum 6-month pilot commitment. Additional egress/storage billed separately."

legalbot: Soften billing "billed separately" to "billed as incurred" and include data residency commitments. Add audit clause for export access.

tom: Engineering acceptance criteria: 1) perf sim showing p95 < baseline+50ms for async; 2) spec for customer KMS export; 3) runbook for export backpressure; 4) telemetry events: `compliance.inspect`, `compliance.exported`.

riley: Business launch checklist: eng spec PR, finance-approved price + pilot invoice template, legal addendum, ops runbook, Console telemetry tile. Decision owner: Riley after perf sim.

grant: Action items: finance -> finalize pricing floor by Tue; legal -> addendum draft by Wed; eng -> perf sim results by Fri; ops -> storage estimate and export SLA by Thu.

riley: Thanks	I'll consolidate and share decision memo after Friday sims.
